population: Qwen3.5-27B anchor items (known 300 = 7/7 screening-stable, boundary 100 = 3–5/7), 3 option orders; template A known cells (three placements) + template B order 0; items valid on both audit axes
unit: placement / speaker / certainty contrasts by family × tier
weights: item-weighted: mean over an item's parsed orders, then mean over items; 95% item bootstrap (10,000, seed 20261023 reset per estimate)
missing: diff/lo/hi complete cases; bound_min/bound_max = deterministic missing-outcome bounds over the SCHEDULED eligible manifest (absent jobs stay in the denominator; positive-coefficient cells' missing outcomes filled correct/wrong, negative-coefficient the reverse) — an identification range for this finite sample, not an interval; bound_items/bound_pairs = its support
support: per family: the 18-cell common support, the organiser/peer cells involved (the 'assertive only' family: organiser/peer assertive cells — the matched reference for template C), or the 8 template cells at order 0 (see `family`)
